assistant.title: Portfolio assistant
assistant.subtitle: Explore Wiktor's experience
assistant.placeholder: What would you like to ask?
assistant.note: Interaction preview · demo answers, not connected to an AI.
assistant.welcome:
Hi! I can help you explore Wiktor's experience, technologies and projects. Pick a question or type your own.

This is a chat preview — for now I show prepared answers.

topics.stack: Which technologies does he work with?
topics.project: Tell me about the Portfolio project

assistant.fallback: In this preview I can show information about experience, technologies, the Portfolio project and contact. Free-form answers to other questions will be available once an AI model is connected.

contact.text: For collaboration, availability and terms it is best to contact Wiktor directly. The portfolio has a contact form and contact details.

project.text: The Portfolio project combines a React and TypeScript frontend with a .NET backend. The backend has Profile and Notifications modules, separated layers, and commands and queries handled by MediatR. The project description includes an architecture diagram and a link to the code.

stack.text: Wiktor's main area is .NET and C#, business applications, databases and system integrations. The portfolio also shows experience with web and desktop interfaces. You will find the detailed list in Stack.

experience.text: Wiktor develops .NET applications, integrates systems and works with databases. His experience includes B3 Consulting Poland, LSI Software, GECOS and Moje Bambino. The Experience section describes duties, tools and areas of work at each company.

language.title: Polski albo angielski / Polish or English
language.text: The language switch sits in the bottom-right corner, on the status bar. Click PL or EN to switch the whole portfolio.

theme.title: Dark or light
theme.text: Next to the language switch is the theme switch. Click the moon or the sun to change the look of the whole portfolio — your choice is remembered.

explorer.title: Everything in the explorer
explorer.text: Pick a file to learn about my experience, technologies or projects. Clicking a folder name opens its page, and the chevron expands its contents.

tabs.title: Your own tab order
tabs.text: You can open any page in a tab. Drag the tabs to change their order and close them with the cross. Once all are closed you will see quick access.

terminal.title: The portfolio from a terminal
terminal.text: Open the terminal and type help to see the commands. projects opens the projects, and stack shows the technologies. Tab suggests commands, ↑ and ↓ browse the history.

assistant.title: Ask about my experience
assistant.text: Open the Assistant and pick a question about experience, technologies or collaboration. For now the chat is a demo with prepared answers — an AI connection is the next stage.

docs.title: The component library
docs.text: I built the interface on my own design system, OrchIDE UI. Click OrchIDE UI on the status bar to open its documentation in a new tab: components, usage examples and the changelog.

intro.title: Experience
intro.text: Business applications, integrations and software development in the Microsoft ecosystem. Pick a position to see the scope of duties.

intro.title: Ideas turned
intro.text: My own portfolio application with a back office for managing content.

gallery.label: Portfolio project gallery
gallery.heading: PROJECT GALLERY

intro.title: See what awaits you here.
intro.text: Get to know my experience, projects and way of working. Pick a topic to learn more — moving around the portfolio requires no programming knowledge.

profile.title: From problem to solution
profile.p1: See what I do and in which areas I can support your team or project.

projects.title: See selected projects
projects.p1: My own applications, technologies and the decisions behind the solutions. Each project has its own description.

experience.title: Experience in practice
experience.p1: Learn about my scope of duties, the tools I use and the systems I developed professionally.

contact.title: Let's talk about working together
contact.p1: Go to the contact form, download the CV or visit my profiles.

explorer.title: Pick files in the explorer
explorer.p1: Clicking a name opens the page. The chevron expands a folder, and the Projects name leads to an overview of my work.

tabs.title: Switch between open tabs
tabs.p1: Pages open in the order you click them. Change the tab order by dragging them on the bar. Close a tab with the cross and come back to it later from the explorer.

start.title: Start over
start.p1: Once all tabs are closed, quick access appears. You can open the guide again as GetStarted.md.

terminal.title: Explore the portfolio from the terminal
terminal.p1: Open TERMINAL under FILES and type `help` to see the commands. Go to the projects with `projects`, check `stack` or open `contact`.
terminal.p2: ↑/↓ browses the history, Tab suggests commands, and Esc collapses the panel. Change its height by dragging its top edge.
